title: Epstein vector zeta functions related to the ADE Lie algebras
summary: We introduce a vector-valued generalization of the Epstein zeta functions associated with the root lattices of ADE-type Lie algebras. The quadratic forms defining these lattices correspond to the Gram matrices of the simple roots. Using the discriminant group D = P/Q, we construct vector-valued theta series that realize the Weil representation of the metaplectic group Mp(2,Z). The proposed Epstein vector zeta functions are obtained as the Mellin transform of these theta series.
